Rule draft

Applies to everyone except household members.

Vigil treats someone as household only when it saw them come out of the house's own doors, or when a household member checked in on the app just before coming into view. Household members arriving from the street without checking in, and anyone Vigil loses track of, count as non-household and can trigger this rule. Vigil places people by where they came from; it does not identify anyone and creates no face, voice or body templates.

'After 9 PM' is read as 21:00 to 06:00; change the end time if you meant something else.
